introduction: A small fix: an old settings window no longer opens by itself when Claude Overhead starts.

cards.title: No stray window when the app starts
cards.summary: Opening Claude Overhead from Spotlight or the Dock, or restarting your Mac, could bring up an old "Claude Overhead Settings" window. It no longer does.
details: The window was left over from before the companion window existed.
Nothing in your settings changes. The real Settings are where they were: the gear in the notch.

cards.title: ⌘, opens the real Settings
cards.summary: Pressing ⌘, in a Claude Overhead window now opens Settings in the companion window. It used to open that old window.
